caption: Abbey of San Galgano, Chiusdino
composition: Roofless Gothic Cistercian abbey with grass nave open to the sky · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The viewpoint stands inside the roofless nave looking toward the east end. The two colonnades of Gothic arches run down the left and right of the frame, converging on the far wall with its great round window above three tall lancets. Green grass carpets the nave floor and soft hills show through the open arches. The modelled scenario is 23 September 2026 at 11:01 Europe/Rome: bright late-morning sun streaming into the open church.
